sources.shortCitation: Film excerpt, Ein toller Einfall (1932): two songs by Jurmann and Kaper
sources.fullCitation: Willy Fritsch, Ellen Schwanneke and Rosy Barsony singing “Du bist der Mann, der den Frauen gefällt” and “Ich suche einen, der mir allein gehört” in the film Ein toller Einfall, directed by Kurt Gerron, 1932; music by Walter Jurmann and Bronislaw Kaper. Excerpt published on YouTube by Alparfan, uploaded 20 March 2015. Accessed 24 August 2026.
sources.title: Ein toller Einfall (1932), film excerpt with two songs
sources.creator: Willy Fritsch; Ellen Schwanneke; Rosy Barsony
sources.researchNote: The excerpt is the only witness traced for this song: no commercial disc of it is recorded in the discographic title lists, which carry only the counterpart sung by Willy Fritsch, “Ich suche eine, die mir allein gehört”. The upload does not say which of the two actresses sings which line, so no performing credit is entered.
